tasks.title: Validate kbd-status behaviour outside a KBD project
tasks.detail: Read skills/*/kbd-status/SKILL.md and determine what it does when .kbd-orchestrator/ is absent. A sessionStart payload runs on EVERY session, including ones unrelated to KBD.
tasks.verify: documented behaviour: graceful degradation, or a decision to choose another skill / drop the change

tasks.title: Emit sessionStart from the generator
tasks.detail: Add "sessionStart": {"skill": "kbd-status"} to the manifest dict in install-kimi-desktop-plugin.sh, conditional on t1 passing.
tasks.verify: generated kimi.plugin.json contains the sessionStart object

tasks.title: Confirm it actually fires
tasks.detail: Restart Kimi Desktop and start a session; confirm the skill is invoked. A present-but-inert field is the failure mode this pack has already hit twice (config.toml hooks, {{file:}} commands).
tasks.verify: observable evidence the skill ran, or a recorded negative result
